entities.summary: Leila Françoise Lassouani is a female weightlifter from Algeria. In 2006, she was named the best Algerian Sportsperson along with swimmer Salim Iles by the Algerian Press. Leila Lassouani was a athletes & competitors from Algeria (b. 1977-07-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
